snippet.title: Bel's Fanfare - Release Date Trailer - FGS Live From LA 2026
snippet.description:
A brand new release date reveal trailer for Bel's Fanfare. Bel's Fanfare is an RPG with rich deep exploration and expressive combat. You play as Bel, the new aura cleaner of the once-luxurious vessel The Witch of the Sea. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
